sermon.title: Speaking
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that our tongues are to speak God’s righteousness, praise, name and word. The Bible was written by God through men who could not keep silent; science’s blunders don’t make people abandon science, and false prophets don’t discredit Scripture. At Pentecost all 120 spoke the mighty works of God, 3,000 were baptized that day, and the church grew as believers spoke.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Acts 10:47 spoken as “10 42”; Elisha’s floating axe attributed to “Elijah”; the “Paul” cited for Ephesians unity; Washington bloodletting (four pints); Piltdown and the 1999 feathered-dinosaur fossil; moon dust 11–13 inches; Time 1977 ice-age claims and Britain under ice; Time 2006/UN/Pentagon climate-refugee predictions by 2010; “2017”. Sensitive content kept as spoken: Catholics and Baptists barring women ministers; usurping authority as wife over husband; a handful of human errors in the Bible; Mormon baptism for the dead.
